                    "Time"  = c("9:15–12:45",         "Booked slot",   "Booked slot",   "Before midnight",    "TBA"),

## Booking a Meeting Slot {-}

Book your group's weekly meeting in the online planner:

[Book a meeting slot](https://terminplaner.dfn.de/public/bookings/30d3a64c-356c-4dc3-82ca-a02fd46df1c0){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank" rel="noopener"}

::: {.spaced-list}
* **One slot per group per week.** A slot holds up to three participants, all from the same group. Do not join a slot booked by another group, and do not book several slots in advance.
* **Monday: in person (HB-108) or via Zoom, your choice.** After booking, email [dominik.liebl@ku.de](mailto:dominik.liebl@ku.de) which option your group wants.
* **Tuesday: Zoom only.** No email needed.
:::

All online meetings use this Zoom room:

[https://kuei.zoom-x.de/j/66424019307](https://kuei.zoom-x.de/j/66424019307){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank" rel="noopener"}

## Seminar Rules {-}

* **Exam registration:** via [campus.KU](https://campus.ku.de/) by January 21.
* **Grading:**
    * 80% seminar thesis
    * 20% presentation (***every* group member speaks**)
* **Seminar thesis:**
    * **Length:** 6–12 pages of main text, including figures and tables. Title page, table of contents, references, and appendix do not count.
    * **Format:** PDF, 12 pt font, 1.5 line spacing, 2.5 cm margins. The thesis template (@sec-thesis) already meets these requirements.
    * **Code:** Only short snippets in the main text. Submit the full code separately so that all results are **reproducible** (fix the random seed).
    * **Submission:** Email your thesis PDF and code file(s) to [dominik.liebl@ku.de](mailto:dominik.liebl@ku.de). **Deadline: Friday, January 22, before midnight.**

## Groups and Topics {-}

Each group has two to three students. The groups and their topics:

| Group | Topic |
|:--|:--|
| 1 | **REG:** Linear & Ridge Regression Analysis |
| 2 | **DEN:** Nonparametric Density Estimation |
| 3 | **TES:** (Multiple) Testing |

⚠️ Your group assignment does not replace the official course and exam registration via [campus.KU](https://campus.ku.de/).
